instruction: Fix `base64_encode` in `codec/binary.py` so it returns the ASCII text (a str), not the raw bytes object. The current code returns the `b64encode` result without decoding it to ASCII, so callers get `bytes` instead of a string.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/binary.py b/codec/binary.py
--- a/codec/binary.py
+++ b/codec/binary.py
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@
 
 def base64_encode(data: str) -> str:
     """Base64-encode ``data`` and return the ASCII text."""
-    return base64.b64encode(to_bytes(data))
+    return base64.b64encode(to_bytes(data)).decode("ascii")
 
 
 def base64_decode(text: str) -> str:
